Entry.JapaneseText: すげー、すげーよなっ！ あの時空戦士たちが、今ここに勢ぞろいってさ！
Entry.EnglishText: This is crazy! Like, seriously *crazy*! We've got *all* the Heroes of Time with us! The whole set!

Entry.JapaneseText: もう<Dio>、いい加減落ち着いてよ
Entry.EnglishText: Jeez... <Dio>, calm down a little, already.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだど、チビ助。<Mel><Mel>の言う通りだ。 テンション上げすぎだーよ
Entry.EnglishText: <Mel><Mel>'s right, pipsqueak. Yer excitement's gotten the better of ya.

Entry.JapaneseText: んだよ！ どんなにすげー事か、 わかってなさすぎだぞ
Entry.EnglishText: The hell!? You don't have *any idea* how crazy this is, do you?

Entry.JapaneseText: あ～ん？ ミーたまと<Suzu>ちんは確かにかわいいだが、 他のはただのぼんくらだぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Hu~h? Miss <Mint>y and Li'l <Suzu> are real cute, sure, but the rest're just a bunch of blockheads, ain't they?

Entry.JapaneseText: 野暮天にキツネ目、酔いどれオヤジに すれっからしだど？ どこがすごいだか？
Entry.EnglishText: Ya got a fox-eyed boor, an old alchie, and a common hussy. What's so amazin' about them?

Entry.JapaneseText: う～ん、いろんな伝記に載ってるぐらいだからねぇ。 後世に名が残るってすごいことだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmmm~ Well, they changed a lot of people's lives. Their names have gone down in history, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: ほれ、みろ！ この書き割りが！
Entry.EnglishText: Take a look at this! You damn stage prop!

Entry.JapaneseText: へん！ おらだって、後世に名が残るだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph! My name'll go down in history, too, ya know.

Entry.JapaneseText: うソ！ アルベルトって、 このあと何か偉大な功績残すつもりなの？
Entry.EnglishText: No way! Is there something incredible you're planning to do with your life, Albert?

Entry.JapaneseText: もちろんだど。 時空戦士とおまけを従え 世界を滅亡の淵から救ったってなぁ、おい
Entry.EnglishText: Of course there is. Leadin' the Heroes of Time and their li'l tag-alongs, I saved the world, now, didn't I?

Entry.JapaneseText: 従えって……、おまえ、いつもポケットの中で、 戦ってねぇじゃんかよ……
Entry.EnglishText: "Leading" us? You spend all your time in our pockets. You never even fight.

Entry.JapaneseText: 自ら動かずして、世界を救った高名な策士として 後世に名を馳せる、だぁ、だぁ、だぁ、だぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Without even liftin' my own fingers, I saved the whole world. A real fine strategist, ain't I?
Entry.Notes: this will 100% have to be edited for context

Entry.JapaneseText: コバンザメみたい、だね……
Entry.EnglishText: So, you're like a parasite, basically...
